I, 39ᶜ sq. <he>לסרסור קנס … ברא דמְסַרְסֵר לארמאי</he> he fined the broker (for selling a camel to a gentile), and they called him a man that serves as a Roman agent. Pesik. Shub. p. 165ᵃ <he>והוה דין מסרסר לדין וכ׳</he> and thus they pimped for one another.
